summary:
The controller side of the ink overhaul is built. The draw-to-attack wiring works in the real app: a mouse drag from Ural to Siberia armed the fight on port 5362, showing the new line and Roll/Blitz. I tested it on the 2D stand-in board (`?stub&debughud`), because the 3D renderer doesn't have strokes yet. When the renderer ships `setStrokeSources`/`onStroke`, the controller picks them up with no further changes.

What's built:
- **Draw-to-attack (A2):** strokes are only offered in the current human's Attack step. They're off while dice roll, during the occupy step, during AI turns, behind the hand-off cover and under menus. A stroke released on a target arms exactly like a tap on that target with that source picked, using the same rule check. A stroke released anywhere else does nothing, and a stroke never rolls. A stroke gets the same guards as a tap: the knockout hold, the guard at the tail of a turn, and click-through while something is animating. Starting a drag dismisses the turn line.
- **Armed line:** `Ural → Siberia · 99% · almost sure` plus at most one stake, biggest first: `knocks out Sam`, then `takes Australia`, then `breaks Sam's Asia`. Hard cap of 60 characters. With long names the odds word is dropped first (the number already says it), then the stake. With the win chance hidden, the word stays and the stake goes.
- **Turn line and grudge line:** the turn line is `John · 3 armies`, or just `John` on a resumed mid-turn. From round 2, a human seat that lost ground gets a grudge line under it: `Sam took Ural and Siberia from you`, or `Sam took Ural, Priya took Peru`. Past 60 characters it falls back to `Sam and Priya took 7 of yours`. The turn line holds 1.0 s, or 1.6 s when there's a grudge line; it never blocks and any input dismisses it.
- **Other lines:** continent `John holds Asia · +7`; elimination `Sam · taken by John · round 9`; victory `John holds the world` with `Round 14 · 31 territories` (or `Round R of L · …`, or `Called in round N · …`). Awards are unchanged: up to 3, Nemesis first.
- **One gold:** the view model now names the single gold element. Order: hand-off cover, then the open Cards sheet's trade, then the pending commit button, then the recommended Turn Track segment, then the current segment. It's null at game over. This deviates slightly from the brief: when nothing is recommended, gold falls back to the current segment instead of nothing. That matches part B §5 and the moodboard, where Attack is gold.
- **Settings:** settings file version 4. The ambient score (`music`) is now on by default, and older files that saved the old `false` default come back on. New `musicVolume` (default 0.7) and a living-board `ambient` switch (default on). The board gets `setAmbient(ambient && !reducedMotion)`, so the setting or the OS preference stills it.
- **Losing stings (A5):** the board is told when the loser is a human through a new `sting` flag on conquest and elimination events. Each seat chip gets a counter that bumps when that seat loses a territory (for the ring dim) and a record of who knocked it out and when (for the empty ring). That record is saved with the game. A human's broken continent plays the audio agent's damped `continent` bowl. The existing `eliminated` sound call is unchanged.
- **Tempo:** no pacing constant changed, no waits were added, and forced wait stays 0.

The debug HUD now shows the new lines and both switches. The stand-in 2D board draws a simple gold stroke, which is what made the in-browser check possible.

**Heads-up:** the new armed-line and victory copy will break several end-to-end checks I don't own. The exact list is under Requests.
verification:
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors across the whole tree at the end. Mid-run, other agents' audio and UI files briefly failed to compile; my files were always clean.
- `npx vitest run`: 19 files, 232 tests passing. `tests/game`: 100 passing (97 before).
- Updated existing game tests for the new copy and the new seat names (Vermilion, Slate, Ochre, Wisteria).
- Added 3 unit tests:
  1. Settings: score on by default, a version-3 file's `music: false` comes back on, a version-4 choice sticks, and reduced motion (setting or OS) stills the board.
  2. Drawing: strokes offered only in Attack; cancelled or still-dragging strokes do nothing; a finished stroke gives the armed line, Roll/Blitz, gold on Blitz and the arrow, and rolls nothing; strokes turn off in Fortify, where gold moves to End turn.
  3. Knockout: epitaph `Sam · taken by John · round 3`, the sting flag on both events, and the seat chip's loss counter and who-knocked-it-out record.
- Also added stake and 60-character checks to `track.test.ts`, the new grudge-line cases to `ledgers.test.ts`, and an epitaph/victory-subline assertion to the all-AI test (no eliminations happen in that game, so the knockout test above is what covers the epitaph).
- Real app on port 5362 (HMR off, `?stub&debughud`, Playwright with the metal flags; server restarted once because it served stale modules, then killed):
  - Mouse drag Ural → Siberia gave `Ural → Siberia · 99% · almost sure`, Roll/Blitz, gold on Blitz, tray `URAL 6 vs SIBERIA 1`.
  - A drag released over open water left nothing armed.
  - A knockout drag gave `Ural → Siberia · 99% · almost sure · knocks out Cobalt` (54 characters); Blitz then showed `Cobalt · taken by John · round 2`.
  - Audio reported music on after the first gesture with fresh storage.
  - Tap-to-target still arms (`Kamchatka → Alaska · 97% · almost sure`).
  - 0 console errors on the stub run.
- Looked at the screenshots: 2-stroke-mid.png shows the gold line following the pointer; 3-armed.png shows the arrow, dimmed land, the line and Roll/Blitz.
- On the real 3D board, `__board.setStrokeSources`/`onStroke`/`setAmbient` were still undefined, and the UI was mid-edit (`SEG_ICON is not defined`), so the draw gesture couldn't be checked there yet.
knownIssues: Not checked on the real 3D board: the renderer didn't expose setStrokeSources/onStroke/setAmbient during my run. The controller calls them only when present and registers onStroke once at startup. No touch-drag check either, because the gesture rules on touch belong to the renderer.

Gold choice to confirm: when nothing is pending or recommended (e.g. Attack with nothing picked), gold falls back to the current Turn Track segment rather than nothing. This follows INK part B §5 and the moodboard. During a roll, gold stays on Blitz while the renderer's gold arrow is also on screen, so the lead should decide whether the arrow counts toward the one-gold check.
The recap keeps a territory's name only once even if it fell twice, and, like before, only counts territories lost since that seat's last turn.
The victory title is 'John holds the world' even for a game ended at the round limit or called early; the subline gives the round and the territory count.
The unpicked Attack prompt still reads 'Click an enemy territory to attack' and doesn't mention drawing. I left it because unit and e2e tests pin it; see Requests.
requests: tests/e2e owner — the armed line gained an odds word and an optional stake. Change the `/^X → Y · \d+%$/` checks to `/^X → Y · \d+% · (almost sure|likely|coin flip|long shot)( · .+)?$/` in: rematch.e2e.ts:45, chain.e2e.ts:54 and :86, keys.e2e.ts:43, budgets.e2e.ts:40, mobile-turn.e2e.ts:113, track.e2e.ts:80, game.e2e.ts:110. With long names the word can drop, so `/^X → Y · \d+%( · .+)?$/` is the safe form.
tests/e2e/autoplay.e2e.ts:72-75 — the victory title is now plain case 'John holds the world'. Match `/ holds the world/` instead of `/RULES THE WORLD/`.

UI agent — read `GameVM.gold` and draw gold on that one element only. Precedence: hand-off ring, then the open Cards sheet's trade, then the primary button, then the recommended segment, then the current segment. Use `BannerVM.line` as the one serif line; for turn banners, `recap` is the grudge line under it. Also read `SeatChipVM.lostKey` (re-run the 300 ms ring dim when it changes) and `SeatChipVM.out` (empty/cracked ring), plus `Settings.musicVolume` and `Settings.ambient` for the Settings sheet (the score is still `music`, now default on). The debug HUD shows the expected behaviour.

Renderer agent — PlayEventOptions.sting is set on a territoryConquered whose previous owner is a human and on a playerEliminated of a human. Play the torn rim, the snap (conquer with variant 'somber' per the audio agent's docs) and the elimination sweep off that flag. setStrokeSources gets a live targets function (it reads the current game state), and it's resent with [] whenever strokes turn off.

Lead, optional — for discoverability, consider making the unpicked Attack prompt 'Click an enemy, or draw from yours' when the board supports strokes. That also means updating keys.e2e.ts:33 and review-r1-verify.test.ts:136.
apiNotes:
Contract changes, all additive:
- BoardView.ts: `PlayEventOptions.sting?: boolean`.
- viewModel.ts:
  - `Settings.musicVolume?: number` and `Settings.ambient?: boolean`. Optional so the UI gallery fixtures still type-check, but the controller always fills them.
  - `SeatChipVM.lostKey?: number` and `SeatChipVM.out?: { by: SeatRef; round: number } | null`.
  - `BannerVM.line?: string`. `title`, `sub` and `recap` keep their old roles; `recap` now holds the new grudge copy.
  - New `GoldVM = {kind:'button',id} | {kind:'segment',seg} | {kind:'cardsTrade'} | {kind:'handoff'} | null` and `GameVM.gold?: GoldVM`.
  - `VictoryVM.title` / `subline` are now plain case: 'John holds the world' / 'Round 14 · 31 territories'.

Test hooks: `__risk.ui()` adds `gold` ('button:blitz', 'segment:attack', 'cardsTrade', 'handoff' or null) and `bannerLine`. The existing `brass[]`, `banners` ('SAM'S TURN · +N') and `recap` are unchanged.

Settings file: SETTINGS_VERSION is now 4. Files older than v4 force `music` to true.

Copy: `strip.ts` exports `attackStake()` and `ATTACK_LINE_MAX = 60`. `recap.ts` exports `RECAP_MAX = 60`; `buildRecap` returns the new grudge format.

Sound: the controller plays `continent` with `{variant: 'somber'}` on a human's continentLost. Board-owned sounds (conquer/hit etc.) are untouched, and the controller keeps its existing calls, including `eliminated` with delay 0.15 after stopAll.

Save data: the saved game meta gains an optional `out` map.
